snippet.title: The End of the World Club - A BL Visual Novel
snippet.description:
The End of the World Club is free a slice-of-life, coming of age BL VN set in 2012 about... doomsday. Coming soon on itch.io and Steam.

Want to support this project? You can:
- Check the Kickstarter page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tomotoad/the-end-of-the-world-club-a-bl-visual-novel?ref=10bdsc
- Play the demo on itch.io: https://tomotoad.itch.io/the-end-of-the-world-club
- Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4811480/The_End_of_the_World_Club/
